a. Successful Bidder must provide the acSoft Inc ServiceNow Power BI plug-in connector. b. Successful Bidder must provide key features of the acSoft Inc ServiceNow Power BI plug-in connector which include: 1. The ability to export any ServiceNow tables and fields (including Custom tables and fields); 2. The ability to include any amount of tables and fields to your Data Source; 3. The ability to create any amount of Data Sources (data sets); 4. No limitations in exported data. To reduce the server load during the export process, the application provides the server-side pagination of data over the OData protocol (limited to 1.000 rows per page); 5. Advanced filtering options to manage data selection and export only the relevant information; 6. Robust permission settings and access management for secure data sharing; 7. Dot-walking mechanism for exporting Reference type data, allowing easy access and inclusion of fields from related tables; 8. Incremental refresh support for efficient Power BI reports and dashboards updates without reimporting the entire dataset; 9. Power Query support (merge ServiceNow with other data sources, transform data and load it into Power BI Desktop with no-code experience); and 10. Pre-typed data, eliminating the need for manual conversion to target types such as integer, boolean, decimal, etc.
